title: Apple: RoomCaptureView with an ARSession
finding: A configured ARSession can be supplied to RoomCaptureView. The desired simultaneous capture configuration must still be tested on hardware.
decision: Use one session owner; RoomPlan is an optional proposal adapter, not a second camera session.

title: Apple: smoothedSceneDepth
finding: The property smooths estimated depth over time compared with sceneDepth.
decision: Use sceneDepth as the measurement stream; smoothed depth may support preview, never an independent second measurement.

title: Apple: scene reconstruction
finding: ARKit provides an estimated scene mesh; plane detection can affect its representation.
decision: Retain calibrated depth and keyframes independently of platform mesh simplification.

title: Apple: RoomPlan capture instructions
finding: RoomPlan already supplies general movement, distance and environment instructions.
decision: Do not claim guidance itself is novel; differentiate target-linked evidence and live reversible corrections.

title: Swift: C++ interoperability status
finding: Interop supports a defined subset; uncaught C++ exceptions must not reach Swift.
decision: Adopt a narrow versioned C ABI and serial ownership wrapper.

title: RTAB-Map iOS NativeWrapper.hpp
finding: Inspected declarations include extern C, opaque object creation/destruction, pose/intrinsics/depth/confidence input and separate export/recovery operations.
decision: Study mobile integration and benchmark workflow; do not copy its parameter-heavy ABI or import the whole dependency graph by default.

title: StandardCyborgCocoa repository
finding: The SDK targets real-time TrueDepth object scanning and separates C++ processing from platform wrappers. It is not a rear-LiDAR room-plan engine.
decision: Architecture/replay reference only; no direct full-room-engine claim.

title: Open3D repository
finding: C++ and Python 3D processing framework with reconstruction and geometry tools.
decision: Use as a separately installed desktop comparison tool; not a mandatory iOS dependency.

title: Open3D TSDF integration tutorial source
finding: Separates sparse block activation from dense integration of observations with poses.
decision: Adopt that separation in the proposed Metal backend; retain an independent CPU oracle.

title: Voxblox repository
finding: CPU volumetric mapping with layers, weighting variants and a separate ROS integration package.
decision: Study bounded blocks/layers and observation weights; do not import ROS or ESDF planning into the core app.

title: Voxblox LICENSE
finding: Root license has BSD-3-Clause terms; README notes inherited components retain their own copyright headers.
decision: Review selected files and transitives before reuse; no source is vendored in this pack.

title: Voxgraph repository
finding: Uses overlapping signed-distance submaps and pose-graph alignment; its documented loop-closure interface is not proof of autonomous detection in our app.
decision: Use submaps as a design reference; map correction needs explicit accepted transforms and rebuild policy.

title: KinectFusion ISMAR 2011 paper
finding: Examines depth unprojection, pose estimation, TSDF integration, raycasting and weighted updates; unknown voxels are distinct from observed zero crossings.
decision: Adapt the geometric concepts, not the paper's hardware-performance numbers. Pages 4 and 5 were inspected visually.

title: BundleFusion project
finding: Combines pose correction and reintegration to address reconstruction inconsistency. Dataset terms are separately restricted.
decision: A pose correction cannot be treated as an overlay-only change; dirty submaps must rebuild from retained evidence.

title: Ceres Solver modeling FAQ
finding: Ceres does not provide built-in general equality constraints, and general inequality support is not equivalent to parameter bounds.
decision: Do not use arbitrarily large weights as hard constraints. Specify a bounded local KKT/SQP constraint path; Ceres remains an optional comparator.

title: Eigen 3.4.0 license readme
finding: Describes MPL2 and third-party components, and the EIGEN_MPL2_ONLY guard.
decision: Select a small reviewed linear-algebra subset with EIGEN_MPL2_ONLY; pin exact artifacts before production integration.

title: Clipper2 repository
finding: Boolean clipping and offsets are available; the reviewed README explicitly cautions about its triangulation code.
decision: Candidate for validated polygon Boolean operations only. Triangulation is excluded from the selected baseline.

title: Earcut.hpp repository
finding: Header-only polygon triangulation with holes; README does not guarantee correctness for all malformed/degenerate inputs.
decision: Candidate for display triangulation of already-validated rings; verify triangle area and boundaries and never treat its output as metric authority.

title: RoomFormer repository
finding: Research predicts floor-plan polygons from scan-derived inputs using a learned model.
decision: Offline benchmark/proposal research, not a substitute for geometric evidence, narrow-feature protection or live human constraints.

title: ARKitScenes repository
finding: Mobile RGB-D data and scene annotations with reference assets support indoor-scene research.
decision: Evaluate dataset suitability and split leakage after license review; collect owner-consented app-specific fixtures regardless.

title: ARKitScenes LICENSE
finding: The inspected file contains noncommercial terms and additional conditional commercial terms. It is not an ordinary unconditional MIT/BSD dataset license.
decision: No dataset was downloaded or accepted for commercial use. Resolve exact terms, affiliate scope and component notices before use.

title: Apple: displaying a point cloud using scene depth
finding: Shows use of scene-depth data and camera calibration in a point-cloud rendering workflow.
decision: Test buffer resolution, orientation and intrinsics explicitly; rendered pixels are not a substitute for calibration.
